components.title: SpatialView
components.description: Give existing widgets perspective and pointer tilt. Keep text editing and popups in the normal layout; native-window and OpenGL children cannot be embedded.

description.en: Enables perspective; default true when motion/theme policy permits it. False restores the same widgets in a native vertical layout with their state intact.
description.zh: 是否启用透视；动效和主题策略允许时默认 true。 关闭后将同一批控件放回原生纵向布局，保留原有状态。

description.en: Perspective distance in logical pixels [100, 10000]; default 1000. A shorter distance increases the apparent size difference between near and far surfaces.
description.zh: 透视距离，逻辑像素范围 [100, 10000]，默认 1000；越小，近大远小越明显。

description.en: Whole-scene magnification [0.1, 4]; default 1. Item poses stay unchanged.
description.zh: 整个场景的显示倍率 [0.1, 4]，默认 1；不改变条目的位置和姿态。

description.en: Tilts the whole scene toward the pointer; default true, active in 3D only.
description.zh: 是否让整个场景随鼠标倾斜，默认 true，仅在 3D 中生效。

description.en: Maximum pointer pitch/yaw, each [0, 45] degrees; default (10, 16).
description.zh: 鼠标跟随的俯仰/偏航上限，各为 [0, 45] 度，默认 (10, 16)。

description.en: Exponential pointer response time [0, 1000] ms; default 140, zero is immediate. Larger values soften the response; this is a time constant, not an animation duration.
description.zh: 指针跟随时间常数 [0, 1000] 毫秒，默认 140；越大越柔和，0 表示立即跟随。 此值是指数响应的时间常数，不是固定动画时长。

description.en: Pointer animation update cap [15, 120] fps; default 60, not measured display FPS.
description.zh: 鼠标动画更新上限 [15, 120] 帧/秒，默认 60，不代表显示器实际帧率。

description.en: Caches widget surfaces; default true. Changed content still repaints.
description.zh: 是否缓存控件表面，默认 true；内容发生变化时仍会重绘。

description.en: Requested renderer: Auto (default), Raster or OpenGL; OpenGL may fall back. Switching waits until active pointer input finishes; inspect activeBackend for the result. Clipped/hidden views release their GPU viewport. Ancestor graphics effects use Raster so the outer compositor can capture the scene; the requested mode remains unchanged.
description.zh: 请求的后端：Auto（默认）、Raster 或 OpenGL；OpenGL 不可用时回退。 切换等待当前鼠标操作结束；使用 activeBackend 查询实际后端。隐藏或完全裁出时释放 GPU 视口；祖先绘制特效启用时使用 Raster 供外层捕获，保留请求的渲染模式。

description.en: Actual renderer, Raster or OpenGL; read-only, initially Raster until exposed.
description.zh: 实际渲染后端 Raster 或 OpenGL；只读，在视图显示并完成初始化前为 Raster。

description.en: Active OpenGL device name; read-only, empty for Raster or before initialization.
description.zh: 当前 OpenGL 设备名称；只读，Raster 或尚未初始化时为空。

description.en: Explanation of automatic renderer fallback; read-only, empty when none applies.
description.zh: 自动回退后端的原因；只读，没有回退原因时为空。

description.en: Number of hosted surfaces, including hidden ones; read-only, initially 0. Externally destroyed content is removed immediately; its notification is coalesced until widget teardown finishes, so handlers may destroy the host.
description.zh: 承载的表面数量，包含隐藏条目；只读，初始为 0。 外部销毁控件时立即移除条目，销毁完成后合并通知，允许回调销毁宿主。

description.en: Give existing widgets perspective and pointer tilt. Keep text editing and popups in the normal layout; native-window and OpenGL children cannot be embedded.
description.zh: 让现有控件以透视方式显示，并随鼠标倾斜。

alt.zh: 空间视图的真实 Gallery 示例

components.title: SpatialItem
components.description: Position, rotate and scale a widget inside SpatialView.

description.en: Pivot position relative to view center in logical pixels; default (0, 0, 0). X points right, Y down and positive Z toward the camera.
description.zh: 轴心相对视图中心的位置，使用逻辑像素，默认 (0, 0, 0)；X 向右、Y 向下、Z 正值朝向相机。

description.en: Rotation about the pivot in X/Y/Z degrees, applied in order; default (0, 0, 0).
description.zh: 绕轴心依次应用的 X/Y/Z 旋转角度，默认 (0, 0, 0)；单位是度，不是弧度。

description.en: Uniform size multiplier for this surface [0.05, 8]; default 1.
description.zh: 单个表面的整体缩放倍率 [0.05, 8]，默认 1。

description.en: Normalized anchor and rotation origin, each axis [0, 1]; default center (0.5, 0.5).
description.zh: 归一化的位置锚点和旋转轴心，各轴 [0, 1]，默认中心 (0.5, 0.5)。

description.en: Visibility in both spatial and native layouts; default true. Use this property instead of hiding the hosted root widget directly.
description.zh: 在 3D 和原生 2D 布局中的可见性，默认 true；使用此属性，而非直接隐藏承载的根控件。

description.en: Strength of the rounded surface shadow and rim, clamped to [0, 1]; default 0. Intended for an intact rectangular Card; decoration does not change content or hit areas. Only drawn in spatial mode.
description.zh: 圆角卡片表面的阴影和边缘高光强度，限制为 [0, 1]，默认 0。 用于完整矩形 Card，不改变内容或命中区域；仅空间模式绘制。

description.en: Temporary upward pointer-hover offset in logical pixels [0, 16]; default 0. Motion freezes during pointer input. Native mode removes it.
description.zh: 悬停时临时向上抬升的逻辑像素数 [0, 16]，默认 0，不修改 position。 鼠标按住时冻结位移，原生平面模式移除此效果。

description.en: Position, rotate and scale a widget inside SpatialView.
description.zh: 设置 SpatialView 中单个控件的位置、旋转和缩放。

alt.zh: 空间项的真实 Gallery 示例
